rows.note: Use 皮膚 as the all-purpose term for the body's outer skin, especially human skin.

example.english: Whenever the seasons change, my skin gets very dry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zyun2 gwai3 pei4 fu1 zau6 hou2 gon1

rows.note: Use 皮 as the everyday general noun when context makes clear whether the referent is body skin, fruit peel, or an animal hide or pelt.

example.english: The skin of this orange is easy to peel.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caang2 ge3 pei4 hou2 jung4 ji6 bok1

rows.note: Use 皮革 for animal skin processed as a material for clothing, upholstery, and similar goods.

example.english: This sofa is made from genuine skin and is very comfortable.
example.traditional: 呢張梳化用真皮革做，坐落去好舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa2 jung6 zan1 pei4 gaak3 zou6 zo6 lok6 heoi3 hou2 syu1 fuk6
